facts.business: Torrent Power Limited is an integrated power utility engaged in generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity across India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Renewable energy pipeline (wind, solar, hybrid, firm-and-dispatchable)
2x800 MW Ultra-Supercritical Coal-based Power Plant at Anuppur, Madhya Pradesh
Capex with environmental and social impact improvements

guidance_or_targets.statement: Ambition to build 10 GW of renewable capacity by 2030
Plant load factors for coal-based plants expected to remain stable at 62%-65% over medium term

auditor.name: Kirit Mehta & Co., Cost Accountants (Cost Auditor); Secretarial Auditor not named in excerpt
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial Audit Report states compliance with statutory provisions and proper Board processes. Independent Auditors' Report contains no qualification.

key_risks: Gas-based generation: 1,567 MW exposed to short-term contracting and merchant market conditions; risk of constrained dispatch due to coal-based capacity growth and renewable expansion
LNG price volatility influenced by geopolitical developments, global supply-demand, shipping constraints; take-or-pay, use-or-pay, ship-or-pay obligations in fuel contracts
Unified pipeline tariff framework ('One Nation, One Grid, One Tariff') may increase transportation charges for plants near gas source, impacting competitiveness
AMGEN 362 MW coal plant non-compliant with SOx emission norms; environmental compensation charge of Rs 0.40/kWh from Jan 1, 2028 if operations continue beyond Dec 31, 2030
Land acquisition challenges for wind projects due to limited high-potential sites, risking sub-optimal generation and higher tariffs
Renewable energy portfolio progress impacted by land availability and site selection constraints
facts.related_party_note: Corporate guarantees given in favour of lenders of subsidiary companies (Solapur Transmission Limited, MSKVY Ninth Solar SPV Limited, Torrent Solar Power Private Limited) recognised as equity investment. Transfer of equity investments in 3 subsidiaries to Torrent Energy Storage Solutions Private Limited (wholly-owned subsidiary) at cost (Rs 0.03 Crore). Acquisition of Torrent Urja 47 Private Limited from Torrent Green Energy Private Limited (wholly-owned subsidiary) at cost (Rs 0.05 Crore). Share Purchase Agreement with Sarawagi Family and related HUFs for acquisition of Newzone India Private Limited and Newzone Power Projects Private Limited (100% share capital) for thermal power project in Anuppur, Madhya Pradesh.
